[Internship-to-Hire Program] Semiconductor Full Custom Layout Design internship
We recruit Full Custom Layout Design interns.
ABC Studio is a Korea–Vietnam IT company specializing in AI and data engineering while also executing projects across diverse IT domains, including semiconductors.
As part of this expansion, we are establishing a dedicated full-custom layout design team to deliver semiconductor layout services in partnership with one of Korea's leading semiconductor design companies. (having projects with top Korean semiconductor manufacturers including Samsung and others)
Through dedicated education and hands-on training, we will bring you up to a level where you can perform fundamental tasks proficiently. This is an excellent opportunity to gain experience through OJT in a professional environment.
This internship is directly linked to full-time employment opportunities. — Interns who receive outstanding evaluations will be offered a full-time position. We encourage all interested candidates to apply.
    
Internship responsibilities 
Support Full Custom Layout Design tasks
Floor Planning
Schematic review
LVS / DRC / DFMC / EM / PEX verification and analysis
 
Training contents 
Overview of full custom layout design
Use of EDA (Electronic Design Automation) tools for design and verification
Understanding of LVS / DRC / DFMC / EM / PEX verification
 
Application process
Application → CV Screening → 1st Interview → 2nd Interview → Intern Selection
For selected interns only: Training & Evaluation (2 months) → Final employment
Results and subsequent schedules will be noticed individually via the email provided at the time of application
The above process/schedule is subject to change due to internal circumstances, and affected candidates will be notified individually.
Application method
Apply via ITVIEC or by submitting your application email with your CV (mail to: )
by 05/10/2026 24:00
Remarks
Interview schedules will be communicated individually only to candidates who pass the document screening
Among selected interns, only those who demonstrate outstanding performance during training and evaluation will be offered final employment
If any false information is found in application documents or in interviews, the offer may be rescinded even after the hiring decision has been confirmed
